svg.title: Source and fusion distribution divergence
svg.desc: The same illustrative paired scores are Gaussian-smoothed with bandwidth 0.08 on a shared unit-score grid. Curves show source A, source B and per-model midpoint distributions. KL and JSD use base-2 logarithms and depend on smoothing.
svg.text: Kullback–Leibler (KL) divergence · A → B 0.068 · B → A 0.058 bits
Smoothing-dependent shape comparison; crosswalk validation still uses matched models.
